data.title: Bitcoin's Bull Score drops to zero, signaling bearish trend: CryptoQuant
data.description: Bitcoin's Bull Score Index has fallen to zero, the most bearish reading the gauge can produce, according to CryptoQuant head of research Julio Moreno.The index runs on a scale of 0 to 100.
